Stefan Syrén, President and CEO of Gunnebo Group, says: “I am excited about the journey ahead for Entrance Control as part of ASSA ABLOY. Over the past decade, we have transformed Gunnebo from an industrial conglomerate into a focused technology company. The combined team brings innovative products, strong service capabilities and highly skilled talent to the market. Altor and Stena Adactum have invested significantly in the business – in our people, new factories, new products, product development, digitalisation and sustainability – with the ambition to build a world-class company. With their continued support, Gunnebo will sharpen its focus on the SecureTech and Safe Storage markets, accelerate innovation, digitalisation and service-based business models, deepen customer relationships and drive customer-led sustainable growth – both organically and through selected acquisitions.”
